calendar_assumptions.limitations: Planning anchors with no terminal partial interval; not a source coverage certificate, actual signals, fills, independent episodes, or untouched OOS.

binomial_model.assumptions: Independent identical Bernoulli net-win outcomes. Comparison counts are sensitivity assumptions, not authenticated project search counts. First crossing need not imply every larger N has80% power. This tests superiority to50%, not a guaranteed high win rate or positive expected P&L.

primary_fee_arithmetic.limitations: Fractional-unit illustration with each entry restored to1000all-in; no dividends, other fees or tick/lot rounding. Not actual fees or strategy returns. Costs are not deducted again from the hypothetical net-win probabilities.

verification.method: Exact integer recurrence cross-checked against direct combinatorial sums
verification.reviewer: same researcher using a second arithmetic formulation

priority_decision: Defer gold-reserve full-history expansion as the next main research task. Source versions remain unresolved and no precise economically justified design yet explains enough usable information after costs. Calendar counts alone do not rule out all monthly designs or strong effects; this is resource prioritization, not an economic rejection or a new minimum-sample gate. Reconsider only a decisive design and genuinely new version evidence, without selecting true win-rate assumptions or horizons to force a pass.
